verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Superhuman Mail as an MCP server: Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants connect to it to drive the inbox and calendar. That is the opposite role from Superhuman consuming external MCP servers' tools, so it earns no credit here. The mentions of agent connectors and 'the work you connect' are generic and never say MCP servers can be plugged in, so they are adjacent at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
